meta_title: Aleksandr Riakhin — Apps for learning, training and everyday life
meta_description: Friendly iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch apps by Aleksandr Riakhin: learn Argentine Spanish with El Recreo, build your own dictionary with My Dictionary, practice with Flippin, train with Replex and fast with PureBite.
meta_og_description: Small, carefully made apps for learning languages, getting stronger and building better habits.
hero_title: I make friendly apps that help you learn, move and feel better.
hero_lead: Small, carefully made apps for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Learn Spanish from your new neighbors in Buenos Aires, keep every word you discover, log your workouts in seconds, or stick to your fasting plan.
apps_subtitle: All free to download on the App Store.
elrecreo_tagline: Learn the Spanish they really speak in Buenos Aires
elrecreo_desc: You've just moved into an old building in Palermo. Rubén greets you at the elevator, Sofi from 4B invites you for mate, and Marta at the corner kiosco saves you an alfajor. Across 60 short lessons you learn real Argentine Spanish — vos, the porteño “sh” and everyday street words — from the people around you.
elrecreo_point3: Unlock songs from the Río de la Plata
mydictionary_tagline: Your own dictionary, in any language
mydictionary_desc: Save the words you come across and get what a real dictionary gives you: clear definitions, example sentences, pictures and pronunciation. Then actually learn them with short daily lessons, flashcards and word games.
mydictionary_point2: Scan words from a page or photo
flippin_tagline: Flashcards you can hear and speak
flippin_desc: Turn the phrases you need into flashcards you can flip, listen to and say out loud. Type a word and the translation fills in, or start right away with free phrase packs for travel, food, shopping and more.
replex_tagline: A gym log that keeps up with you
replex_desc: Log every set in seconds on your iPhone or Apple Watch, see every personal record, and watch yourself get stronger week after week. Pick a ready-made plan or let the AI coach build one for you.
replex_point2: Rest timer on your Lock Screen
purebite_desc: Pick a plan like 16:8, start your fast and follow it right from your Lock Screen. See which fasting stage you're in, and when your eating window opens, get quick, high-protein recipe ideas.
guarani_desc: A fast, clean currency converter for anyone living in or traveling to Paraguay, with quick access to recent rates.
pricewizard_desc: Set fair prices for your subscriptions and in-app purchases in every country, then update App Store Connect safely in bulk.
about_p1: I've been building apps for Apple devices since 2020. By day I'm a senior iOS engineer on apps used by millions of people; the rest of the time I make my own apps — usually because I wanted them myself.
about_p2: Most of them started as something I wanted for myself: a better way to learn a language, keep track of training, or stick to a healthy habit. I keep improving them every month.
value1_text: Every app is free to download and useful from the first minute.
value2_text: Questions and ideas come straight to me, and I read every message.
value3_text: Widgets, Lock Screen, Apple Watch and iCloud — where it makes sense.
work_subtitle: Hiring an iOS engineer? I'm a Senior iOS Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit, from trading apps to MAPS.ME. I use AI tools like Claude, Codex and Cursor every day and build AI features into my own apps. Based in Brazil.
job1_text: Brought SwiftUI into a large UIKit trading app, speeding up development by 60%, and built real-time trading dashboards. Led backend-driven UI for a government services app.
job2_text: Worked on MAPS.ME (5M+ downloads): migrated Objective-C to Swift, redesigned Favorites and Routing, cut the crash rate by 35%, and was interim iOS Team Lead for 6 months.
job3_text: Built an AR navigation prototype, accessibility-focused educational apps for children, and payment flows for a coffee chain.
contact_text: A question about one of the apps, an idea for a feature, or a job opportunity — I'd love to hear from you.
beta_title: Try my apps on Android early
beta_text: My apps are coming to Android. Join the test group to get new versions before everyone else and help me make them better.
